annotations.title: Query metrics with groupBy and granularity

description: One metrics read over what Hermoso already measures, shaped the way a report wants it. entity posts (posts, measured, reach, engagement, engagementRate for posts PUBLISHED in the window; groupBy channel, account, media, hour, dayOfWeek, post), accounts (followers and followerChange per account from the daily follower reading; groupBy account, channel or none) or inbox (received, sent, response times, reply rate; groupBy none or channel). granularity total, day, week (weeks start Monday) or month. Window: days (default 30) or fromDate + toDate. Reach and engagement are never added across platforms: a grouping that would pool them is split by channel, and the reply says so. metrics_catalog lists every metric, grouping and limit. Read-only, 0 credits.
